Hail and lightning on the exposed part. Nowhere to hide up there, so I just kept moving, fast, down to the first trees.
Thunder right overhead on the high stretch, the gap between flash and boom down to a second. Crouched on my pad between strikes, then moved fast.
Caught above treeline when the storm hit. Hair standing up, poles buzzing. Ran for the trees and didn't stop until I was well below the ridge.
Thunderheads building over the pass. Stopped below treeline and waited it out under the trees, counting seconds between flash and boom.
